title: Pure Cubic
summary: Pure Cubic OTK and Cubic Counter climb build with generic staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Duza the Meteor Cubic Vessel and the Cubic Spells/Traps load the GY to search Crimson Nova the Dark Cubic Lord, while Vijam the Cubic Seed fuels the Cubic Kings and Beasts.

summary.title: Starters
points: Duza the Meteor Cubic Vessel sends any Cubic card from the Deck to the GY when Normal or Special Summoned, usually Cubic Karma (to banish and search any Cubic monster) or Unification of the Cubic Lords (to banish and summon a Cubic from the Deck).
Cubic Dharma prevents all battle damage from your Cubic monsters' battles, discards a Cubic card to draw 1 card, and banishes itself from the GY to recover a Cubic monster.

Cubic Karma sends Vijam the Cubic Seed from the Deck to the GY on activation to boost a Cubic by 800 ATK per Vijam, and banishes itself from the GY to search any Cubic monster (including Crimson Nova).

summary.title: Opening: Duza the Meteor Cubic Vessel
steps: Normal Summon Duza the Meteor Cubic Vessel and use its effect to send Cubic Karma from the Deck to the GY.
Banish Cubic Karma from the GY to add Crimson Nova the Dark Cubic Lord (or a third Cubic card name) from the Deck to your hand.
Reveal 3 other Cubic cards with different names in your hand to Special Summon Crimson Nova the Dark Cubic Lord, or use Cubic Wave and Karma to push for an immediate 3000+ double-attack OTK.

summary.title: Vijam & The Cubic Climb
points: Vijam the Cubic Seed cannot be destroyed by battle, places itself in the Spell and Trap Zone after battling to put a Cubic Counter on the opposing monster (negating its effects and preventing it from attacking), and Special Summons itself back during your Main Phase.

Dark Garnex and Geira Guile (send 1 Cubic), Blade Garoodia and Vulcan Dragni (send 2 Cubics), and Buster Gundil and Indiora Doom Volt (send 3 Cubics) Special Summon themselves from the hand by sending Cubics you control to the GY, then tag out after battle or burn to revive Vijams from the GY and search the next tier.

summary.title: Bosses, Spells & Traps
points: Crimson Nova the Dark Cubic Lord (3000 ATK) is unaffected by other monsters' activated effects whose original ATK is 3000 or less, attacks a second time after destroying a monster by battle, and burns both players for 3000 LP during your End Phase.

Crimson Nova Trinity the Dark Cubic Lord (4500 ATK, fused via Unification of the Cubic Lords) cannot be targeted or destroyed by opponent's card effects, halves the opponent's LP every time it declares an attack, and attacks a second time after a battle destruction.

Cubic Wave doubles a Cubic monster's ATK while halving an opponent's monster's ATK, Cubic Ascension summons Vijams from the Deck when the opponent attacks, and Cubic Causality distributes Cubic Counters and burns from the GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Five OCG/anime-only Cubic cards (Pritima the Infinity Cubic Vessel, Cubic Bodhi, Alditia Hell Blaze, Divine Anima Infinity, and Abyss Vagrada) are excluded as they are not released in the TCG.
